name: Hendel taken into custody

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Hendel is subdued and placed in Jaina and Tervosh’s custody.
description: Hendel resists when confronted, and nearby guards join the struggle. The adventurer subdues him; Tervosh and Jaina arrive, and custody passes to them. The chain ends with a prisoner and a name already connected to Varian’s ship, not with the king’s rescue. No later comic, later game account, or unseen voyage is used to close the gap. The investigation has found a participant, while its central disappearance remains unresolved.
